title: 第二十五章 猎场第二十六章 枪术
content_zh:
“原来是王家的五少爷！”
周白筠笑着道。
刚刚的情绪瞬间消失不见。
来之前她早已对东海市大大小小的家族做过一个详细的了解，此时经过孙高言的介绍，她便知道了王腾，许杰和白薇几人的身份。
随后简单聊了几句，她微微致歉，向其他人走去。
等她走远，许杰低声道：“这周白筠，怕是看不上我们几家。”
周白筠虽然没有表现出来，但是明显感觉得出来，她对王腾这一群人的态度不像对其他人那么热情。
孙高言的脸色则是有些难看，许杰几人是他叫来的，周白筠如此态度，让他脸上无光。
王腾拍了拍他的肩膀：“不要在意，我们今天纯粹是来混吃混喝，至于结交朋友倒是其次。”
“高言，别在意别在意，白白吃喝玩乐一天，也很不错的啦。”
许杰嘻嘻哈哈道。
经他一打岔，几人的心情顿时好了不少。
“你们说，李荣成怎么跟周白筠走到一起去了？按理说，李家的层面还够不到周家吧。”
白薇这时突然问道。
“听说周白筠在招揽武徒，尤其是那些有望武者的高级武徒。”
孙高言说道。
“这么说就不奇怪了，李荣成成为高级武徒之后，李家便将这事大肆宣扬，生怕别人不知道，所有人都说李家出了个天才，日后必定要有一名武者了。”
余浩也加入了讨论。
“哼，武者岂是那么容易练成的，高级武徒不算稀少，可是能成为武者的却寥寥无几，一千名高级武徒里面都不一定能出一个武者，就李荣成，李家就是砸锅卖铁都未必能把他堆上去。”
许杰很是不爽，不屑的说道。

“但是这并不妨碍周白筠现在对他的拉拢。”
白薇讥嘲道。
“广撒网，多捕鱼！
李荣成大概就是其中一只鱼，不过周白筠要是知道王腾哥你的实力……嘿嘿！”
许杰幸灾乐祸的笑了起来。
“这种事情和我无关，就算她对我再好，我也不会掺和其中的。”
王腾摇头道。
孙高言心中一动，此时两人的谈话，再配合之前李荣成的脸色……
一番脑补，他似乎发现了什么，眼中闪过一道精光。
不过他也没有特别表现出来，态度和之前一样，只是有意无意的融入了王腾这个小团体之中。
孙高言的性格，余浩和白薇并不排斥，王腾虽然看出了什么，但并未多说。
再加上他又是许杰的表弟，有这一层关系在自然更容易被他们接受。
所以一时间几人相谈甚欢。
……
中午，到了饭点。
一盘盘精美的菜肴被摆上了桌，香味扑鼻，让人口舌生津。
“这是……星兽食材！”
余浩多少见过，此时低声道。
“周白筠也是下了大手笔了，这些星兽食材可是要花费不少钱。”
许杰感叹道。

众人纷纷上桌，其他人都往周白筠旁边凑，不一会儿就占据了餐桌的前端。
整个餐桌呈长形。
content_en:
"It turns out to be the fifth young master of the Wang family!"
Zhou Baijun said with a smile.
The emotion just now disappeared in an instant.
Before coming here, she had already had a detailed understanding of the large and small families in Donghai City. At this time, through Sun Gaoyan's introduction, she knew the identities of Wang Teng, Xu Jie and Bai Wei.
After a brief chat, she apologized slightly and walked towards the others.
When she walked away, Xu Jie whispered: "I'm afraid Bai Jun doesn't like our family this time."
Although Zhou Baijun didn't show it, she could clearly feel that her attitude towards Wang Teng's group was not as enthusiastic as towards others.
Sun Gaoyan's face was a little ugly. He was the one who called Xu Jie and the others. Zhou Baijun's attitude made his face look dull.
Wang Teng patted him on the shoulder: "Don't worry, we are just here to eat and drink today, and making friends is secondary."
"Gao Yan, don't worry, don't worry, it's not bad to have a day of eating, drinking and having fun."
Xu Jie laughed and said.
After his interruption, the mood of several people suddenly improved a lot.
"Tell me, why did Li Rongcheng and Zhou Baijun get together? Logically speaking, the Li family is not as good as the Zhou family."
Bai Wei suddenly asked at this time.
"I heard that Zhou Baijun is recruiting martial disciples, especially those high-level warriors who are promising warriors."
Sun Gaoyan said.
"It's not surprising to say that after Li Rongcheng became a high-level martial arts disciple, the Li family publicized the matter widely, for fear that others would not know. Everyone said that the Li family had a genius and that there must be a warrior in the future."
Yu Hao also joined the discussion.
"Hmph, how can it be so easy to become a warrior? High-level warriors are not rare, but there are only a few who can become warriors. There may not be a warrior among a thousand high-level warriors. As for Li Rongcheng, even if the Li family sells iron, they may not be able to get him."
Xu Jie was very unhappy and said disdainfully.
"But this does not prevent Zhou Baijun from wooing him now."
Bai Wei sneered.
“Cast the net wide and catch more fish!
Li Rongcheng is probably one of them, but if Zhou Baijun knew your strength, Brother Wang Teng...hehe! "
Xu Jie laughed happily.
"This kind of thing has nothing to do with me. No matter how nice she is to me, I won't get involved."
Wang Teng shook his head.
Sun Gaoyan's heart moved. The conversation between the two at this time, combined with Li Rongcheng's face before...
After thinking about it for a while, he seemed to have discovered something, and a light flashed in his eyes.
However, he didn't show it in particular. His attitude was the same as before. He just integrated into Wang Teng's small group intentionally or unintentionally.
Yu Hao and Bai Wei didn't reject Sun Gaoyan's character. Although Wang Teng saw something, he didn't say much.
In addition, he is Xu Jie's cousin, so it is easier for them to accept him with this relationship.
So for a while, several people chatted happily.
…
At noon, it’s time for dinner.
Plate after plate of exquisite dishes were put on the table, the aroma was fragrant and made people salivate.
"This is... star beast food!"
Yu Hao had seen it several times before and whispered at this time.
"Zhou Baijun has also made a big deal. These star beast ingredients cost a lot of money."
Xu Jie sighed.
Everyone came to the table one after another, and everyone else moved closer to Zhou Baijun, and soon occupied the front of the table.
The entire dining table is elongated.
